variants.L0_legacy: Control: per-fold percentile rank of the refitted Sep 15 legacy OOF score
variants.L1_legacy_x_pa_morgan: legacy rank x P(D6 primary log2fc < -1) from the Morgan gate
variants.L2_legacy_x_sqrt_pa_morgan: legacy rank x sqrt(Morgan gate p_active)
variants.L3_legacy_x_sqrt_pa_both: legacy rank x sqrt(Morgan x CheMeleon gate p_active)
variants.L4_rankmean_legacy_pool: Equal per-fold percentile-rank mean of legacy and pool_lgbm
variants.L5_gate_filter_tau0.2: Legacy ranking restricted to Morgan p_active >= 0.2, then filled
variants.L5_gate_filter_tau0.3: Legacy ranking restricted to Morgan p_active >= 0.3, then filled
variants.L5_gate_filter_tau0.4: Legacy ranking restricted to Morgan p_active >= 0.4, then filled
variants.B_pool_lgbm: Reference: per-fold percentile rank of pool_lgbm

config.rate_selection: Pooled test-like MCC on the other outer folds; ties go to the lower rate
config.status: Read-only concordance and combination diagnostic; no candidate, submission or upload

caveats: Seven transitions share one hidden blind set; they are not independent trials
The public Live MCC is itself an estimate on an unknown scored subset
Pseudo-negative labels are inferred from the primary screen, not measured
Blind variant vectors are diagnostic; no candidate or submission was prepared
